_about: Public-domain James Hope Moulton (1863-1917), Methodist scholar of New Testament Greek and of Zoroastrianism, lost at sea in 1917, for the Word Hoard: A Grammar of New Testament Greek, vol. I, Prolegomena (1906), The Vocabulary of the Greek Testament with George Milligan (Part I, 1914), An Introduction to the Study of New Testament Greek (1895), Early Religious Poetry of Persia (1911), Early Zoroastrianism (1913), Religions and Religion (1913), From Egyptian Rubbish-Heaps (1917) and The Treasure of the Magi (1917), from Internet Archive scans. Not Richard Green Moulton, whose shelf is moulton. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jhmoulton-prolegomena: A Grammar of New Testament Greek, vol. I, Prolegomena, based on W. F. Moulton's edition of G. B. Winer's Grammar (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1906)
jhmoulton-vocabulary-1: The Vocabulary of the Greek Testament Illustrated from the Papyri and other Non-Literary Sources, Part I, by James Hope Moulton and George Milligan (London: Hodder and Stoughton; printed 1914)
jhmoulton-intro-nt-greek: An Introduction to the Study of New Testament Greek (London: Charles H. Kelly, 1895)
jhmoulton-religious-poetry-persia: Early Religious Poetry of Persia (Cambridge: University Press, 1911)
jhmoulton-early-zoroastrianism: Early Zoroastrianism, the Hibbert Lectures, second series, 1912 (London: Williams and Norgate; year OCR'd '193', catalogued 1913)
jhmoulton-religions-religion: Religions and Religion, the Fernley Lecture (London: Charles H. Kelly, 1913)
jhmoulton-egyptian-rubbish-heaps: From Egyptian Rubbish-Heaps, second edition (London: Charles H. Kelly, 1917)
jhmoulton-treasure-magi: The Treasure of the Magi (London: Humphrey Milford, 1917)

_alternates.jhmoulton-copies: The second edition of the Prolegomena (1906); the complete Vocabulary printed 1929; Two Lectures on the Science of Language (1903); the 1926 Early Zoroastrianism reprint

_excluded.jhmoulton-other: Grammar vol. II (completed after his death by an editor not named in the OCR); the memoir of his father W. F. Moulton
